question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution: The correct answer is **embedded**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Embedded:** past participle of embed; to fix something firmly and deeply (in something else). किसी वस्‍तु को (अन्‍य वस्‍तु में) मज़बूती से बैठाना, जड़ना • **Embedded** is the right word here. • Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2 is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Inserted: **to put something into something or between two things. निविष्‍ट करना, अंतर्निविष्ट करना, अंतःस्‍थापित करना • **Planted: **to put plants, seeds, etc. in the ground to grow. ज़मीन में उगने के लिए पौधे लगाना, बीज बोना • **Stuck: **not able to move. अटका हुआ, रुका हुआ 42:T820, The correct answer is **processes**.
